howto.name: Reverse the page order
howto.text: Page N becomes page 1, page N-1 becomes page 2, etc.

howto.name: Download the reversed PDF
howto.text: Useful for fixing back-to-front scans, creating countdown documents, or reverse-chronological annual reports.

faq.a: Most common: rescue a scan where pages came out in reverse order. Also: countdown PDFs (10, 9, 8…), reverse-chronological logs.
Yes — bookmarks pointing to page N are rewritten to point to page (total - N + 1).
Page numbers stamped with the Page Numbers tool are part of page content; they don't auto-update. Reverse first, then re-add page numbers.
